recent.text: Jamahl Mosley on Jaron Pierre Jr.'s day: "Pure basketball. He just loves to hoop. You see the joy and the energy he brings to the table... He could've kept playing. That's what you want from a young rookie, to play for the joy of the game, the spirit to help his team win a game."
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Learning he played total of 59 minutes Saturday, a somewhat surprised Jaron Pierre Jr. responded, "An hour of work today." Asked if he could've played another 20-30 minutes of ball, a smiling Pierre said, "I wish (the game vs. Denver) had went to overtime. I'd have kept it going"
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Asked if this weekend's hectic schedule (he played three games in roughly 24 hours) reminded him of AAU ball, Jaron Pierre Jr. said, "From the outside looking in, it may have seemed like AAU ball, but for me, I haven't played three or four games in one day SINCE then!"
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Jaron Pierre Jr. on what he did between playing 36 minutes in G League morning game and 23 minutes in #NBA game tonight: "I didn't have time to do anything. I had to get straight to the (arena) and get ready."
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Rookie guard (and New Orleans native) Jaron Pierre Jr. provides energy and spark for #Pelicans with 13 pts, but Nuggets hold off their hosts for 116-108 road victory in New Orleans. Zion Williamson 24 pts. Postgame wrap: https://t.co/F5fZxkfYZL https://t.co/E4VauHdi3o
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Pelicans lose 116-108 to Nuggets. Lousy start to 4th quarter (16-5 run by DEN) was difference. Shame Pels had worst FT shooting of season (63%, missed 12 FT). Pels' D didn't allow over 30 PTS in any frame. Zion Williamson: 24 PTS, 6 REB Saddiq Bey: 16 PTS Jaron Pierre Jr: 13 PTS
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: Pelicans trail Nuggets 86-82 after 3. Strong close by New Orleans, despite Pierre's tip-in not counting at buzzer. Bench has played really well, with Poole, Queen and Pierre shining most. Zion Williamson: 18 PTS, 2 3s Jaron Pierre: 13 PTS, 2 3s Jordan Poole: 11 PTS, 5 AST
